description: Real checksums, sizes, and roundtrip measurements for the default definition, generated by running the actual exporters during Sprint 7.

step.whyChecksumVaries: The exported STEP file's ISO-10303 header embeds a wall-clock FILE_NAME timestamp (e.g. '2026-08-24T20:37:42') and a PRODUCT entity name containing an incrementing translator-instance counter (e.g. 'Open CASCADE STEP translator 7.9 2') — both confirmed by diffing two exports of the identical GeneratedModel line-by-line during Sprint 7. Every other line (4310 of 4315 in the observed diff) was byte-identical, confirming the actual B-Rep geometry data itself is fully reproducible; only these two non-geometric metadata fields vary.
